brief: Alternate crystal-arena backdrop concept for the Mega Drive Splash V3, keeping a dark logo-safe center, side crystal formations, and a bright lower-center convergence while using larger, cleaner facets and less surface noise.
prompt_constraints: No lettering, logos, symbols, frames, or watermark.
Avoid small speckle texture, checkerboard repetition, noisy dithering, smooth gradients, and photorealistic texture.
Keep the central logo zone dark and crystals away from it.
translation_gate: Translate to 320x224, 4bpp, no more than 15 visible colors, and 8x8 tile alignment.
Inspect the logo-safe zone, highlight footprint, and convergence at native resolution and in the exact ROM.
Do not promote generated pixels or this source to final without future human curation.
